title: Bulk confirmation title and first line give the count
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A], [Part-B] = tracked parts, active; [Part-C] = tracked part, set inactive in Setup. Numbers share the start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTITLE-0.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BTITLE A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTITLE-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTITLE-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BTITLE A).
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BTITLE B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTITLE-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTITLE-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BTITLE B).
  5. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BTITLE C), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTITLE-03), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  6. [Part-C] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTITLE-03); [Desc-C] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BTITLE C).
  7. Set [Part-C] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-C], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  8. Check the setup worked: [Part-A], [Part-B] on the Active tab; [Part-C] on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab search "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTITLE-0", open the ⋮ menu and click "Deactivate parts".
  2. Tick [Part-A] and [Part-B], click "Deactivate" in the bulk bar and read the dialog.
  3. Click "Cancel", untick [Part-B], click "Deactivate" and read the dialog.
  4. Click "Cancel", click × on the bulk bar, open the Inactive tab, search "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTITLE-0", open ⋮ and click "Activate parts".
  5. Tick [Part-C], click "Activate" in the bulk bar and read the dialog, then click "Cancel".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The confirmation opens before anything changes, titled "Deactivate parts?", first line "2 parts selected."
  • Step 3: Titled "Deactivate parts?", first line "1 part selected."
  • Step 4: The mode on the Active tab ends and the Inactive tab's bulk mode starts.
  • Step 5: Titled "Activate parts?", first line "1 part selected." No part changed status.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S10-R1, S10-R3, S10-R4, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 4.4 (Confirm) and 4.7 (Confirm the reactivation). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R3: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation is titled "Deactivate parts?" or "Activate parts?". Raised from the part dialog, it is titled "Deactivate part?" or "Activate part?".”
  • S10-R4: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation opens with "{n} parts selected.", or "1 part selected." for one. Raised from the part dialog, it opens with the part number followed by the description, as they stand in the form, with spaces before and after removed.”
  • S10-R1: “A status change is confirmed before it is applied, from either entry point: the bulk bar (Stories 2 and 3), or Save in the part dialog after the user picks a different Part Status (S13-R21).”
